office: the Department for Registration of Persons

routes.label: through the Grama Niladhari and Divisional Secretariat; the card is mailed
one-day service at the Department: within 3 hours of handing in the application

note: Every citizen of 15 or over must apply. The Department's schedule of fees lists Rs 2,000 for a card under the one-day service, Rs 200 or 500 for a revised copy and Rs 1,000 for a duplicate of a lost card (not modelled), but no line for a first card under the normal service, so that fee is null; the card's term isn't on its pages either, so it's null; the player is told.

sources.title: Department for Registration of Persons, Sri Lanka, Obtaining National Identity Card for the first time
sources.said: Every person who is a citizen of Sri Lanka and who has attained or attains the age of 15 years shall apply for a National Identity card. ... For issuance of National Identity Cards under One Day Service. Rs.2000.00

sources.title: Department for Registration of Persons, Sri Lanka, FAQ
sources.said: the National Identity Card can be obtained within 3 hours of handing over the application.
